::: {#fig-not-invertible}

```{r}
#| label: not-invertible-alt
#| include: false
fig_alt <- paste(
  "The parabola y = x^2 is crossed twice",
  "by the dotted horizontal line y = 4, at x = -2 and x = 2,",
  "which are marked."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: not-invertible-plot
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt
x_square <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)
square_data <- data.frame(x = x_square, y = x_square^2)
marked <- data.frame(x = c(-2, 2), y = c(4, 4))

not_invertible_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 4, colour = "grey40", linetype = "dotted") +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = square_data,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y),
    colour = "#0072B2"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = marked, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y), size = 3) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -2.8, y = 4.6, label = "y = 4") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = -3:3) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Input, x", y = "Output, h(x) = x^2") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::div(
    role = "img",
    `aria-label` = fig_alt,
    plotly::ggplotly(not_invertible_plot)
  )
} else {
  not_invertible_plot
}
```

The horizontal line $y = 4$ meets the [graph](#def-graph) of $h(x) = x^2$ twice, at $x = -2$ and $x = 2$,
so $h$ has no [inverse function](#def-inverse-function).

:::
